facts.fact: June 在 before nine 带着足够喂饱一支军队的肉桂卷到达，并在 by noon 离开，期间不知怎么让 Sugar 和 Pine 自愿去负责 cider station（苹果酒摊位）。
facts.anchor: June had arrived before nine with enough cinnamon rolls to feed an army and left by noon after somehow volunteering Sugar and Pine to run the cider station

facts.fact: Darlene 花了 four hours 把 miniature scarecrows 绑到栅栏柱上，直到 Carson 通知她奶牛正在吃这些稻草人。
facts.anchor: Darlene spent four hours attaching miniature scarecrows to fence posts until Carson informed her the cows were eating them

facts.fact: Dad 花了一整天修 James 的一台旧拖拉机，尽管被告知 approximately twelve times 说没人指望它能发动起来。
facts.anchor: he spent most of the day working on one of James’s old tractors despite being told approximately twelve times that nobody expected him to get it running

facts.fact: Carson 说这件事发生在她 fourteen 岁那年（one year），James 花了整场开幕之夜（opening night）跑 extension cords，还大声咒骂到坐干草车的孩子都学会了几个新词。
facts.anchor: that happened one year when she was fourteen, and James had spent most of opening night running extension cords

facts.fact: Beau 给了她 ten minutes，自己忙着收集空水瓶并折叠两条没人收的 tarps（two tarps）。
facts.anchor: I gave her ten minutes, keeping myself busy by gathering empty water bottles and folding two tarps nobody had bothered putting away

facts.fact: 三十分钟后（thirty minutes later）Beau 走向他的卡车时，牧场依然灯火通明，Carson 送他出来并保持几英尺距离。
facts.anchor: When I finally headed toward my truck thirty minutes later, the ranch still glowed behind us. Carson walked me out

facts.fact: Carson 对 Beau 说她已经给他做过三次午餐（lunch three times），坚持不肯放过高笼统的账。
facts.anchor: I’ve made you lunch three times

facts.fact: Beau 想起第一次见 Carson 的那个下午，她浑身湿透走进他的店铺还瞪着他——只因他竟敢建议冒雷暴走 two miles 是个坏主意。
facts.anchor: walking two miles through a thunderstorm was a bad idea
